why: cmux https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/51768 (Leo 2026-11-24: live pane pictures in the hover cards, cached, rapid, very low cost). The App owns the only map from a tab id to its live content (TabContentCache's terminals and browsers, the made chat views), so it says how each kind of tab is pictured live: TabPreviewSource+Watch builds a PanePictureWatch.Source per kind from those (revision, change observer, capture), the browser observer lives in CmuxNextBrowser, TabPreviewSource implements TabPreviewProvider.watchPreview, and SidebarBridge sets SidebarView.tabPictureWatcher. When a watched tab is pictured is Rust (cmux-pane-pictures, PanePictureSchedule); the watch, its cache and timers are in CmuxNextBridge (PanePictureWatch); a chat's picture and push hook in CmuxNextAgentPane; a terminal's change watch in CmuxNextTerminal.
